messages.text: Hello, I wish to know something about my ····, it was delivered at Shipbob inc. on august 28th. After that I haven’t heard nothing. I written 2 mails since september 16th, but I haven’t received an answer yet
I can see that RMA here. Before I pull the details, one quick check so I know I'm on the right record: what's the email the RMA was filed under, or the postcode ···· from? Either one works.
My mail is (email hidden) and it was shipped from Italy, postal code ····

Thanks Claudio, that matches.

Your unit is logged as received on August 28, and an RMA should be processed within 10 days of arriving. A month with no word, and two emails unanswered, is on us, not you. I'm sorry.

I've pinged Abel and Georges on it now. Stay in the chat if you can, one of them will jump in here with the outcome on your NerdQX. If you step away, the answer comes to your email.
Thank you fo the quick reply
Before you go, one thing: what went wrong with the NerdQX that sent it back?

The fuse blown, so I changed it with another identical, but when I plugged the miner at the wall blown again. Then I troed a third time, with the same result. The miner worked well for some day before that happened

That sounds like a dead short on the input side, not a fuse problem. Good that you stopped at three.

The second NerdQX from that order, is that one still running fine?

You're right, one NerdQX, one payment. My mistake reading the lines.

So it ran fine for a few days, then killed three fuses in a row. That's the detail the team needs on the RMA, and it's in the chat for them now. They'll come back to you here or by email.
Anytime, Claudio. Hang tight, Abel or Georges will pick this up shortly.
